Powell |asst_coach3 = Quinton Ferrell |asst_coach4 = |stadium = [[TD Arena]] |champion = CAA regular-season co-champions and [[2018 CAA men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |bowl = [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = first round }} {{2017–18 CAA men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Charleston Cougars men's basketball team''' represented the [[College of Charleston]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cougars, led by fourth-year head coach [[Earl Grant (basketball)|Earl Grant]], played their home games at the [[TD Arena]] in [[Charleston, South Carolina]] as members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA). They finished the season 26–8, 14–4 in CAA play, to share the regular season title with [[2017–18 Northeastern Huskies men's basketball team|Northeastern]]. At the [[2018 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]] they defeated [[2017–18 Drexel Dragons men's basketball team|Drexel]], [[2017–18 William & Mary Tribe men's basketball team|William & Mary]] and Northeastern to become CAA tournament champions. They earned the CAA's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 College of Charleston Cougars men's basketball team|Cougars]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 25–10, 14–4 in CAA play, to finish in second place. In the [[2017 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 James Madison Dukes men's basketball team|James Madison]] in the quarterfinals and [[2016–17 Towson Tigers men's basketball team|Towson]] in the semifinals, before losing to [[2016–17 UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball team|UNC Wilmington]] in the championship game. They were then invited to participate in the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], where they lost to [[2016–17 Colorado State Rams men's basketball team|Colorado State]] in the first round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
